extracted.name: Spicy asparagus & chorizo baked egg
extracted.description: Need a speedy one-pot meal for busy weekdays? Try this spicy baked egg on a bed of asparagus and chorizo - it takes just 25 minutes from prep to plate
instruction_lines: Heat a small non-stick frying pan over a medium heat, add the asparagus and chorizo and fry for 8 mins. Stir through the paprika, cooking for a further 1 min.

Stir the spinach into the pan and cook for 5 mins until wilted before stirring through the crème fraîche. Season, then make a well in the middle of the mixture and crack the egg into it. Cover the pan and cook for 5-6 mins or until the egg is just set. Serve with a flatbread, if you like.
